```{r}
#| label: load-pkgs
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(broom)
```


```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| message: false
#| warning: false

pluto <- read_csv("../data/pluto_res3plus.csv")
noaa_daily <- read_csv("../data/noaa_daily_centralpark.csv")
registrations <- read_csv("../data/hpd_registrations.csv")
violations <- read_csv("../data/hpd_heat_violations.csv")
complaints <- read_csv("../data/hpd_heat_complaints.csv")
```

```{r}
noaa_daily <- noaa_daily |>
  mutate(TAVG = (TMAX + TMIN) / 2)
```


```{r}
daily_complaints <- complaints |>
  mutate(day = as_date(received_date)) |>
  count(day, name = "n")

ggplot(daily_complaints, aes(day, n)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Heat complaints per day")

```

```{r}
daily_complaints |>
  filter(month(day) %in% c(12, 1, 2), n < 100) |>
  arrange(n)
```

```{r}
daily <- daily_complaints |>
  left_join(noaa_daily |> mutate(day = as_date(DATE)), by = "day")

ggplot(daily, aes(TMIN, n)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_smooth() +
  labs(x = "Daily low (F)", y = "Heat complaints per day")

```
```{r}

daily |>
  filter(month(day) %in% c(11, 12, 1, 2, 3)) |>
  mutate(wday = wday(day, label = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(wday) |>
  summarise(avg = round(mean(n)), median = median(n))
```


```{r}
bad_days <- as_date(c("2017-12-31", "2018-12-30", "2019-12-29",
                      "2020-12-27", "2020-12-28", "2021-12-26"))

daily_clean <- daily |> filter(!day %in% bad_days)
```

```{r}
heat <- complaints |>
  filter(problem_code %in% c("NO HEAT", "NO HEAT AND NO HOT WATER"))

by_bldg <- heat |>
  count(bbl, name = "n") |>
  arrange(desc(n))

nrow(by_bldg)

by_bldg |>
  mutate(share = cumsum(n) / sum(n)) |>
  slice(c(100, 500, 1000, 5000))

```

```{r}
heat_viol <- violations |>
  filter(as.character(ordernumber) %in% c("666", "966", "674"))

buildings <- pluto |>
  left_join(heat |> count(bbl, name = "complaints"), by = "bbl") |>
  left_join(heat_viol |> count(bbl, name = "violations"), by = "bbl") |>
  mutate(across(c(complaints, violations), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))

glimpse(buildings)

```

```{r}
buildings <- buildings |>
  mutate(
    per_unit = complaints / unitsres,
    size = cut(unitsres,
               breaks = c(2, 5, 19, 49, 99, Inf),
               labels = c("3-5", "6-19", "20-49", "50-99", "100+"))
  )

buildings |>
  group_by(size) |>
  summarise(
    buildings      = n(),
    avg_complaints = round(mean(complaints), 1),
    avg_per_unit   = round(mean(per_unit), 2),
    pct_ever       = round(mean(complaints > 0) * 100)
  )

```


```{r}
bad_days <- as_date(c("2017-12-31", "2018-12-30", "2019-12-29",
                      "2020-12-27", "2020-12-28", "2021-12-26"))

days <- heat |>
  mutate(day = as_date(received_date)) |>
  group_by(day) |>
  summarise(complaints = n_distinct(complaint_id)) |>
  right_join(noaa_daily |> mutate(day = as_date(DATE)), by = "day") |>
  filter(day >= as_date("2017-07-01")) |>
  mutate(
    complaints  = replace_na(complaints, 0),
    TAVG        = (TMAX + TMIN) / 2,
    wday        = wday(day, label = TRUE),
    heat_season = month(day) %in% c(10, 11, 12, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
  ) |>
  filter(!day %in% bad_days) |>
  arrange(day) |>
  mutate(tmin_lag1 = lag(TMIN, 1)) |>
  select(day, complaints, TMAX, TMIN, TAVG, SNOW, AWND, wday, heat_season, tmin_lag1)

glimpse(days)


```


```{r}
buildings <- buildings |>
  mutate(size = cut(unitsres,
                    breaks = c(2, 9, 29, 99, 299, 999, Inf),
                    labels = c("3-9", "10-29", "30-99", "100-299", "300-999", "1000+")))

buildings |>
  group_by(size) |>
  summarise(
    buildings      = n(),
    avg_complaints = round(mean(complaints), 1),
    avg_per_unit   = round(mean(per_unit), 2),
    pct_ever       = round(mean(complaints > 0) * 100)
  )

```


```{r}
buildings |>
  summarise(
    zero    = sum(yearbuilt == 0),
    is_1900 = sum(yearbuilt == 1900),
    total   = n()
  )

```

```{r}
buildings |>
  filter(yearbuilt > 0) |>
  mutate(era = cut(yearbuilt,
                   breaks = c(0, 1899, 1900, 1939, 1969, 1999, Inf),
                   labels = c("pre-1900", "1900", "1901-1939",
                              "1940-1969", "1970-1999", "2000+"))) |>
  group_by(era) |>
  summarise(
    buildings    = n(),
    avg_per_unit = round(mean(per_unit), 2),
    pct_ever     = round(mean(complaints > 0) * 100)
  )
```

```{r}
buildings <- buildings |>
  mutate(yearbuilt = na_if(yearbuilt, 0))
```


```{r}

days |>
  filter(heat_season) |>
  summarise(
    same_day = cor(TMIN,      complaints, use = "complete.obs"),
    one_day  = cor(tmin_lag1, complaints, use = "complete.obs")
  )
```

```{r}
buildings |>
  filter(!is.na(yearbuilt)) |>
  mutate(
    altered = yearalter1 > 0,
    prewar  = yearbuilt < 1940
  ) |>
  group_by(prewar, altered) |>
  summarise(
    buildings    = n(),
    avg_per_unit = round(mean(per_unit), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
buildings |>
  group_by(size) |>
  summarise(
    buildings      = n(),
    avg_complaints = round(mean(complaints), 1),
    avg_per_unit   = round(mean(per_unit), 2),
    pct_ever       = round(mean(complaints > 0) * 100)
  )
```
